Mia Chen: quick async — consolidating INC-834 postmortem action items. please reply with your item, owner (if not you), and firm due date (YYYY-MM-DD). i'll compile and push to the tracker.

Raj Patel: i'll take k8s autoscaler tuning — owner Raj Patel — due 2026-04-02. will open helm PR by Mon.

Olivia Park: i'll handle log retention & export (S3 lifecycle + export job) — owner Olivia Park — due 2026-04-06. need infra help for bucket ACLs.

Sam Diaz: taking the chooser fallback policy change + unit tests — owner Sam Diaz — due 2026-03-28. will request quick CR slot Wed.

Naomi (PM): noting two cross-team deps: infra to confirm S3 ACL timeline, security to review fallback for PII flows. @infra-bot can you ack?

infra-bot: INF-4321 received: S3 ACL request logged. ETA 2026-03-25. JIRA: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/INF-4321

Mia Chen: @Raj please add a short rollout plan (canary %s + fallback) so SRE can sign off.

Raj Patel: canary plan: 5% -> 20% -> 100% over 48h, check latency and error rate at each step. rollback if p50 latency increases > 100ms or error rate > 0.5% sustained for 15m. i'll paste helm snippet in PR:
```yaml
canary:
  steps: [5, 20, 100]
  monitor: latency,error_rate
  rollback_conditions:
    - p50_delta_ms: 100
    - error_rate_pct: 0.5
```

Olivia Park: one more ask — who owns the prod eval prompt set? @Sam can you do harness + Naomi curate golden prompts?

Sam Diaz: i can own eval harness integration and tests, but not prompts. i'll set up CI job and a test flip.

Naomi (PM): i will own golden prompt set curation — due 2026-03-30. will coordinate with ProductOps for examples.

Mia Chen: perfect. i'll update the RCA doc and add these to the action tracker. quick asks: (1) if you expect blockers that push beyond your due date, call them out here now; (2) add PR/JIRA links as you open them.

Raj Patel: no blockers expected from infra side for the tuning itself.

Olivia Park: potential blocker — S3 IAM change may require biz-approval; if that stalls, retention/export moves out by ~2w. i'll flag ASAP.

Sam Diaz: FYI i'll request a rapid CR review slot Wed 10-11 PT, @Mia can you nudge reviewers then?

Mia Chen: will nudge. final owners snapshot: Raj (autoscaler), Olivia (retention/export), Sam (fallback + harness), Naomi (golden prompts). i'll schedule a mid-week checkpoint (Wed) calendar invite and post the tracker link. :thumbsup:

Naomi (PM): :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Reminder: INF-4321 S3 ACL follow-up scheduled for 2026-03-25 09:00Z.

Mia Chen: thanks everyone. if there are no new updates by 2026-03-27 i'll assume items are on track and we can close the RCA backlog entries. otherwise post updates here or directly in the tracker.
